basic_details.short_information: Numaligarh Refinery Limited (NRL) has announced a contractual engagement for 5 Advisor positions in refinery operations for up to 12 months, offering a fixed monthly remuneration between Rs. 1,00,000 and Rs. 1,25,000. Candidates with a BE, B.Tech, B.Sc (Engg.), B.Sc, or Diploma in Engineering and at least 15 years of relevant plant operation experience may submit their applications online through the official portal from 23 October 2026 (10:00 hrs) until 12 November 2026 (23:59 hrs).

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted exclusively online through the company portal. Follow these steps to complete the submission:
Visit the official website at www.nrl.co.in.
Navigate to Career, select Term Engagement (Contractual Basis), and click on Current Term Engagement (Contractual) Opportunities.
Open the link for Advertisement No. 13/2026 (C).

Prepare and upload a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) in the prescribed NRL format containing the declaration: 'No vigilance case or departmental proceedings or criminal prosecution were contemplated or pending at the time of his/her retirement'.
Upload a recent passport-size photograph, proof of Date of Birth, and educational qualification documents.
Review the submitted details and finalise the online submission before 23:59 hrs on 12 November 2026.

Candidates must possess a valid mobile number and email ID, which should remain active until the selection process is complete, as no change will be allowed once entered. Candidates are responsible for receiving and downloading communications, and NRL will not be responsible for any loss of email or SMS sent due to invalid or wrong contact details.

Candidates must ensure that all information furnished is true; any incorrect information will lead to summary rejection of candidature without assigning reasons. No hard copy of the application or supporting documents should be sent by post to Numaligarh Refinery Limited. For updates, candidates should check the Career page regularly; legitimate queries can be mailed to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About NRL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Numaligarh Refinery Limited (NRL) is a Navaratna Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas engaged in refining and marketing petroleum products. The company is currently executing a mega refinery expansion project to ramp up refining capacity from 3 MMTPA to 9 MMTPA, which includes crude oil importation at Paradip Port and laying a cross-country pipeline from Paradip to Numaligarh. This recruitment engages experienced retired or serving professionals to support critical refinery operations during this expansion.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible retired or other experienced professionals from NRL, OIL, other PSUs, Government departments, or the Private Sector who satisfy the following criteria as on the cut-off date of 12 November 2026. Additional eligibility requirements stated in the notification include: CPSU Grade Requirement: Officers superannuating from a Central Public Sector Undertaking (CPSU) must have retired from Grade 'C', 'D', or 'E'. Age Limit: Maximum 65 years of age as on the cut-off date (12.11.2026). The notification does not provide category-based age relaxations. Vigilance Clearance: No vigilance case, departmental proceedings, or criminal prosecution should be contemplated or pending at the time of retirement or applying. Medical Fitness: Candidates must produce a fitness certificate before engagement, and the opinion of the Hospital or Medical Officer authorised by NRL is final.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely contractual for a maximum duration of up to 12 months from the date of joining. Remuneration is an all-inclusive fixed monthly lumpsum with no additional allowances. Statutory deductions such as TDS will be deducted from the monthly remuneration, against which necessary certificates will be issued. Outstation tour travel will be compensated with TA/DA as per the applicable NRL equivalent grade rate. Appointees will work in line with the regular officers of the company, observe normal office timings, and may be called upon to attend office on weekly off days or any holiday in case of urgency. During their engagement they shall not be allowed to take any other assignment. Advisors are entitled to 20 days of paid leave for every 12 months on a pro-rata basis, and normal company holidays of NRL will be applicable.

rows.fixed_monthly_remuneration: Rs. 1,00,000/- to Rs. 1,25,000/- (based on last drawn pay and experience)

content_sections.heading: NRL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Imparting expert guidance during boiler commissioning, and trial runs. Overseeing high-pressure boiler operations and ensuring best operating practices and statutory IBR/BOE compliance. Conducting technical training for new Operators/ Attendants. Any other assignment assigned by the Reporting Officer. Guiding commissioning, stabilization, and performance guarantee test runs of ETP. Overseeing Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) operations, troubleshooting process parameters, and ensuring strict environmental/pollution control compliance. Conducting hand hold training for the new Operators. Any other assignment assigned by the Reporting Officer. Guiding commissioning and performance testing of new Nitrogen Plant. Operation of Nitrogen Plant. Conducting hand hold training for new Operators on operation. Any other assignment assigned by the Reporting Officer. Guiding commissioning and testing of new DM plant. Operation of new DM Plant. Conducting hand hold training for new Operators. Any other assignment assigned by the Reporting Officer.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under NRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 5 Advisor positions are available across Boiler Operation (2), ETP Operation (1), Nitrogen Plant Operation (1), and DM Plant Operation (1).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The closing date for online submission of applications is 12 November 2026 at 23:59 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a BE, B.Tech, B.Sc (Engg.), B.Sc, or Diploma in Engineering with at least 15 years of plant operational experience. Candidates applying for Advisor (Boiler Operation) must also possess Boiler Operation Engineer (BOE) certification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Advisor posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 65 years as on the cut-off date of 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly remuneration for selected Advisors?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated remuneration is Rs. 1,00,000/- (Grade 'C'), Rs. 1,12,500/- (Grade 'D'), or Rs. 1,25,000/- (Grade 'E') for CPSU retirees, and between Rs. 1,00,000/- and Rs. 1,25,000/- for private or government sector professionals.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be selected through a Personal Interaction, which may take place either physically or virtually.

faq.question: Q7. Is this engagement permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: This engagement is purely on a contractual tenure basis for a maximum period of up to 12 months from the date of joining.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Selected Advisors will be posted in Numaligarh, with liability to travel to other company work locations as required by the job.
